title: Radler-EMS: Energie
description: Leistungen, Ladestände, Prognose und Preise. Quelle simulator oder geraet (Tag quelle).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "geraete")
  |> range(start: -15m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pv" and r._field == "leistung_W")
  |> group()
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "PV"})

from(bucket: "geraete")
  |> range(start: -15m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "haus" and r._field == "verbrauch_W")
  |> group()
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "Haus"})

from(bucket: "geraete")
  |> range(start: -15m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "netz" and r._field == "bezug_W")
  |> group()
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "Netz (+ Bezug)"})

from(bucket: "geraete")
  |> range(start: -15m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "batterie" and r._field == "leistung_W")
  |> group()
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "Batterie (+ Entladen)"})

from(bucket: "geraete")
  |> range(start: -15m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "wallbox" and r._field == "leistung_W")
  |> group()
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "Wallbox"})

from(bucket: "geraete")
  |> range(start: -15m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "wp" and r._field == "leistung_W")
  |> group()
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "Wärmepumpe"})

from(bucket: "geraete")
  |> range(start: -15m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "batterie" and r._field == "soc_pct")
  |> group()
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "Batterie"})

from(bucket: "markt")
  |> range(start: -1h, stop: 15m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "strompreis" and r._field == "preis_ct")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._time <= now())
  |> group()
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "ct/kWh"})

panels.title: Energie im Zeitraum (kWh)
panels.description: Summe über den oben gewählten Zeitraum

targets.query:
t0 = from(bucket: "geraete")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pv" and r._field == "leistung_W")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value}))
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> integral(unit: 1h)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value / 1000.0}))
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "PV")
  |> set(key: "x", value: "1")
  |> keep(columns: ["x", "_field", "_value"])
t1 = from(bucket: "geraete")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "haus" and r._field == "verbrauch_W")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value}))
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> integral(unit: 1h)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value / 1000.0}))
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "Haus")
  |> set(key: "x", value: "1")
  |> keep(columns: ["x", "_field", "_value"])
t2 = from(bucket: "geraete")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "netz" and r._field == "bezug_W")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: if r._value > 0.0 then r._value else 0.0}))
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> integral(unit: 1h)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value / 1000.0}))
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "Bezug")
  |> set(key: "x", value: "1")
  |> keep(columns: ["x", "_field", "_value"])
t3 = from(bucket: "geraete")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "netz" and r._field == "bezug_W")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: if r._value < 0.0 then -r._value else 0.0}))
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> integral(unit: 1h)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value / 1000.0}))
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "Einspeisung")
  |> set(key: "x", value: "1")
  |> keep(columns: ["x", "_field", "_value"])
t4 = from(bucket: "geraete")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "wallbox" and r._field == "leistung_W")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value}))
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> integral(unit: 1h)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value / 1000.0}))
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "Auto")
  |> set(key: "x", value: "1")
  |> keep(columns: ["x", "_field", "_value"])
t5 = from(bucket: "geraete")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "wp" and r._field == "leistung_W")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value}))
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> integral(unit: 1h)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value / 1000.0}))
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "Wärmepumpe")
  |> set(key: "x", value: "1")
  |> keep(columns: ["x", "_field", "_value"])
union(tables: [t0, t1, t2, t3, t4, t5])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["x"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> drop(columns: ["x"])
